definitions.full: H286. Achilud אֲחִילוּד proper name, masculine (according to Thes = יְלוּד אֲחִי child's brother (?) ) 1 father of Jehoshaphat, David's chronicler 2Sam 8:16 ; 20:24 ; 1Kin 4:3 ; 1Chr 18:15 . 2 father of Baana, officer of Solomon 1Kin 4:12 .
definitions.rootNote: from 251 and 3205 ; brother of one born;
